title: Luxurious Silky Japanese Mushrooms Yakitori
description: A bitter and silky Japanese dish featuring mushrooms, perfect for a brunch mood, originating from Okinawa, and egg-free friendly, served in yakitori form

ingredients.name: Shiitake mushrooms
ingredients.notes: stems removed and caps sliced into 1/4 inch thick pieces

instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together sesame oil, soy sauce, rice vinegar, mirin, sugar, and salt.
Add the sliced mushrooms to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Let the mushrooms marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Cut the parchment paper into 6 inch squares and place a mushroom slice in the center of each square.
Fold the parchment paper over the mushroom to form a triangle and press the edges to seal.
Place the mushroom packets on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the mushrooms in the preheated oven for 12 minutes.
Remove the mushrooms from the oven and let them cool for a few minutes.
Serve the mushrooms hot, garnished with scallions and sesame seeds.
